diagnosis: FeatureFlagSelfEnrollView allows any authenticated user to enroll their user account into any django-waffle Flag by name. The endpoint fails to restrict enrollment to flags designated for public beta testing, enabling regular users to self-assign unreleased administrative, billing bypass, or internal security debugging flags.
exploit_request:
POST /api/features/flags/billing_limit_bypass/self-enroll/ HTTP/1.1
Host: api.saasmetrics.io
Authorization: Bearer customer_user_token
Content-Length: 0
